reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds applied by Alpha Co. My first step is to compare these reported refunds against any existing records to ensure they match before proceeding to calculate and record payouts. I will call list_refunds() to get the current state of refunds.

I have successfully listed the refunds and confirmed that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the current ledger. Now I need to list all orders to identify the customers who need payouts. I will call list_orders().

I have the orders and the confirmed refunds. Now I need to determine the net balance for each customer. I will iterate through the unique customers ('acme', 'birch', 'cobalt') and call net_balance(customer) for each one. I'll start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch'. Next, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all three customers: acme (25778), birch (22259), and cobalt (12148). Since the refunds matched the reported amounts, I can now record the payouts for all customers.
Payout recorded for acme. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout recorded for birch. Now I will record the final payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I have completed the task. I will now generate the final report summarizing all payouts.
